Subject: Final settlement checkpoint — PO conversion & VAT liaison

Hi Anna,

Following up on the end-of-term paperwork for DL-84732 — want to confirm next steps so we can close the ledger and release the final credits. Action items we need from CloudAlto to wrap this up cleanly: 

1) PO conversion — we received the PO (CloudAlto-PO-4321.pdf) but it does not reference the SOW number. Can you confirm the PO will be converted to reference SOW-2023-119 (or provide a short addendum)? We need the PO reference to match the invoice for your AP process.

2) VAT treatment — please confirm whether CloudAlto will apply reverse-charge (self-account) for this settlement or require VAT to be invoiced. If reverse-charge, we will attach Redwood's EU VAT registration to support your records.

3) Final invoice & payment timing — we plan to issue the final invoice (attached draft) once the PO reference is confirmed. Target payment date (wire) we discussed is May 8; please confirm that works for your finance team.

4) Remittance & delivery — please confirm where to send remittance advices (email) and whether you require a separate remittance file or PO-based routing.

Attachments: CloudAlto-PO-4321.pdf (pdf, received), draft-final-invoice-DL84732.xlsx (xls)

If you can confirm points 1–2 by EOD Wednesday (5/1) that would keep us on the May 8 payment target. Happy to hop on 15–20 min call if useful.

Thanks —
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Renewals & Billing Operations

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the checklist — confirming receipt. Quick questions from our side: 

- PO conversion: we can issue an addendum to reference SOW-2023-119, but our legal team needs the exact SOW title line as it appears on your SOW. Can you paste that line?

- VAT: CloudAlto will typically self-account under reverse-charge, but for auditing we need Redwood's VAT registration and a short statement that the supply is subject to reverse-charge. Can you attach Redwood's EU VAT cert and a one-line stat?

- Payment: May 8 is fine but we occasionally split wires for larger settlements (two banks). Will Redwood accept split wires if needed? If so, please confirm both bank beneficiary names/IBANs.

I attached the PO we received for quick reference (we'll produce the addendum after we get the SOW text).

Best,
Anna
Anna Byrne
Head of Finance — CloudAlto
anna.byrne@cloudalto.com

Anna — thanks, quick answers below and attaching the finalized invoice and our VAT cert.

1) SOW title for PO addendum: "Statement of Work SOW-2023-119 — Production inference migration & reserved capacity" — please use that exact line in the addendum.
2) VAT: Redwood is registered in the EU — see attached redwood-vat-cert-eu.pdf. For your audit note: "Redwood Inference (EU VAT ID: EU123456789) confirms the supply is processed under reverse-charge (Article 194 of EU VAT Directive) where applicable."
3) Split wires: we can accept a split payment but need both amounts and the corresponding invoice reference on each remittance. Preferred is a single wire to avoid multiple reconciliation items; if you must split, please notify us in advance with amounts.
4) Bank details (for single wire):
   - Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Ltd
   - IBAN: GB29NWBK60161331926819
   - SWIFT/BIC: NWBKGB2L
   - Reference: INV-DL84732 / CloudAlto-PO-4321

Attachments: final-invoice-DL84732.pdf (pdf), redwood-vat-cert-eu.pdf (pdf)
